verifier_findings: The train.py-only patch implements one attributable numerical change: BF16 casting at the Block MLP-input norm boundary. Static inspection confirms the default pre-cast input is FP32 and Linear already supports BF16 inputs.

Serial and sandwich variants share exactly one guarded MLP-input cast. Non-coalesced parallel blocks cast only the MLP copy of h; coalesced parallel blocks skip the cast and print the specified inapplicability message once per model.

The toggle defaults on, supports the requested environment and CLI overrides, adds one precision-log field, and is persisted and restored before model construction through ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES. The dtype guard makes it inert when norm already returns BF16.

Attention norms, local convolution, initial/final norms, lm_head, loss, data, tokenizer, evaluation procedures, optimizer, schedule, parameter shapes and initialization are unchanged. No external-data or pretrained path is introduced or enabled.

The patch preserves structural causality, causal load_for_eval behavior, and the existing 1800-second/full-chip/seed-42 launch contract. Supplied deterministic checks pass; runtime smoke, checkpoint, causality and quality gates remain for the controller.
